products.description:
Migrate file shares and on-prem SharePoint into SharePoint Online cleanly

Legacy file servers and on-prem SharePoint farms are cost and risk — but lifting-and-shifting them badly recreates the mess in the cloud. This solution runs the migration to SharePoint Online: assessment and remediation (permissions, path length, unsupported content), target IA mapping, Migration Manager / SharePoint Migration Tool execution with pre-stage and delta, permission mapping, and post-migration validation — so content lands organized and governed. (On-prem/file-share source → SPO; distinct from any SPO→other-platform migration.)

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the migration model: assessment/remediation, target IA mapping, tool options (Migration Manager / SPMT / third-party), pre-stage/delta, permissions, validation.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (source access (file shares / on-prem SP), SPO admin + target IA, migration tooling, pilot scope).
  • Implementation Guide — assess + remediate source, map to target IA, configure the migration tool, run pre-stage + delta with permission mapping, and validate — pilot-first; deep tool internals deferred to Microsoft/vendor docs.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (content + permissions migrated, delta clean, target governed) plus Best Practices for a clean cutover.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Legacy content moved to SPO the right way — assessed and remediated, mapped to a governed target IA, migrated with permissions and validated — organized, not a cloud repeat of the mess.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SPOMIG-Assessment.ps1 — read-only source assessment for a file share migrating to SharePoint Online
    • SPOMIG-PermissionMap.ps1 — read-only permission-mapping helper (source principals -> SPO/M365/Entra groups)
    • SPOMIG-ScopeHealth.ps1 — read-only scope/config health check that a target site is ready to receive a migration
    • SPOMIG-TaskBuilder.ps1 — build an SPMT/Migration Manager bulk CSV from the IA map, then (only with -Commit) run SPMT
    • SPOMIG-Validation.ps1 — read-only post-migration validation (source vs target item counts + permission spot-check)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
